nofrendo_start.tooltip: Start the NES emulator and load the specified ROM path (such as /sdcard/game.nes). The SD card and TFT screen need to be initialized first.

nofrendo_find_rom.message0: Find .nes game files on SD card
nofrendo_find_rom.tooltip: Search for the first .nes file in the root directory of the SD card and return the full path. If not found, an empty string is returned.
